display_name: The air battle's radio sets and our intercept receivers, 1985
status: B9, 17 November 2026. The radios the flights, controllers and request nets talk on, and the receivers of our intercept posts (docs/air_battle/09_COMMS_AND_INTERCEPT.md section 2.1 and 4.2). Bands are sourced; powers and sensitivities of the class are labelled estimates (no tier 1-4 source read gives an air set's power for NATO or a 1985 Pact intercept receiver).
notes: Used by a scenario's "air_radio" block (simcore/air_radio_def.hpp). No HAVE QUICK II and no Compass Call in the 1985 theatre (docs/air_battle/09 section 1.3).
